facts.fact: Xalam Analytics' market brief lists, among Nigerian government initiatives, the launch of the Project 774 Local Government Connectivity Initiative to provide local governments with reliable internet access; it gives no launch date (dated here to the brief's publication), no count connected and no funding.

The brief says the government launched Project 774 to provide local governments with reliable internet access, an initiative of the state for the local governments themselves; it states a launch only, with no office said to be connected yet and no date (dated here to the brief's publication).
The brief gives the purpose of Project 774 as reliable internet access for local governments and names no system the offices would work in; no date is given (dated here to the brief's publication).

systems.tiers: local governments, to be given reliable internet access; no count stated
